metadata.description: My personal collection of Claude skills

plugins.name: proposal-evolution
plugins.description: Converts a project proposal into a prompt optimized for the taches create-meta-prompts skill

plugins.name: article-fact-checker
plugins.description: Evaluates the factual reliability of any article. Checks facts, quotes, numerical claims, cited source fidelity, and manipulative framing. Returns a structured report with per-claim verdicts and reliability scores.

plugins.name: facebook-article-fact-checker-adapter
plugins.description: Facebook-specific adapter that extracts article content shared via Facebook posts and delegates to article-fact-checker. Also analyzes whether the Facebook post itself adds misleading framing beyond the linked article.

plugins.name: design-with-fable
plugins.description: Turns a project idea or proposal into a complete planning artifact set: optional research doc, design doc, sized implementation plan (S/M/L/Huge) with independent verification, concurrency waves with gates, an orchestrator prompt runnable by Claude Code or Codex, a human-inputs doc, and an effort comparison.

plugins.name: ralph-waves
plugins.description: Executes a design-with-fable plan folder as an autonomous wave-by-wave implementation loop: sized sub-agent workers, one-size-below independent verification, wave gates, retry/escalation ladder, infrastructure-error recovery, and no commits ever.

plugins.name: session-retro
plugins.description: Analyzes past Claude Code session transcripts for token efficiency, usage habits, and API-equivalent cost attribution. A deterministic parser aggregates session JSONL into compact metrics; Claude then judges causes, counterfactuals, and safe cuts vs load-bearing spend.
